name: Kamojima (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kamojima town emblem in yellow: a disc with a stylised bird's head at the upper hoist and a navy crescent.
history: Flag of the former town of Kamojima in Tokushima Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-10-01.

features.role: Kamojima town emblem — a disc with a stylised bird's head at the upper hoist and a navy crescent
